newsitem.title: USA: Harley-Davidson union workers approve pact.
newsitem.headline: Harley-Davidson union workers approve pact.

text.p: Harley-Davidson Inc and its York, Pa. motorcycle production and maintenance employees jointly said that union members approved a new five-year labor agreement.

There are currently 2,123 International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers union-represented employees at the York plant. The previous labor agreement expired shortly after midnight on February 2.
Under the new contract, employees will receive general wage increases of three percent per year, with a one-time cash payment.
The contract also calls for pension benefit and insurance coverage enhancements.
Harley-Davidson Motor Co produces heavyeight motorcycles and a complete line of motorcycle parts, accessories and apparel.
